The Exodar (pronounced EX-o-dar) is the draenei's enchanted capital city located on Azuremyst Isle. It is a dimensional ship satellite structure of the dimensional fortress known as Tempest Keep that crashed on Azeroth. Like other dimensional ships, the Exodar was able to transcend dimensions and warp time itself, but now acts solely as home of the draenei on Azeroth.
The Exodar contains a large amount of technological wonders, such as tall pillars of lavender lightning in the city districts are part of a system that courses threads of arcane power through the Exodar.

{{RaceIcon|Draenei Male}} [[Triumvirate of the Hand]]''[[Prophet's Lesson]]'' | languages = [[Draenei (language)|Draenei]], [[Common (language)|Common]] | faiths = [[Light|Holy Light of Creation]], [[Shamanism]] | affiliation = [[Exodar (nation)|Exodar draenei]], [[Alliance]] | loc = Western [[Azuremyst Isle]] | territory = Alliance | status = Active }} '''The ''Exodar''''' (pronounced EX-o-dar)[[The Vindicaar (quest)]] is the [[draenei]]'s enchanted [[capital city]] located on [[Azuremyst Isle]]. It is a [[Dimensional Ship|dimensional ship]] satellite structure of the dimensional fortress known as [[Tempest Keep]] that crashed on [[Azeroth]]. Like other dimensional ships, the ''Exodar'' was able to transcend dimensions and warp time itself,[[Shard of the Exodar]] but now acts solely as home of the draenei on [[Azeroth]]. The ''Exodar'' contains a large amount of [[Tempest Keep|technological wonders]], such as tall pillars of lavender lightning in the city districts are part of a system that courses threads of [[arcane]] power through the ''Exodar''.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 60 ==History== [[File:TheExodarConcept.jpg|thumb|Concept art of the ''Exodar''.]] The [[naaru]] helped built the ''Exodar'', with [[M'iri]], [[K'yal]], and [[E'ira]] each designing one district: the [[Trader's Tier]], the [[Vault of Lights]], and the [[Crystal Hall]], respectively.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 60 - 61 Prior to the [[invasion of Outland]], the [[Army of the Light]] was unable to directly assist [[Velen]] and [[Khadgar]] despite hearing their pleas, due to their open war against the [[Burning Legion]] on [[Argus]]. The naaru, [[A'dal]], [[M'uru]], and [[O'ros]], however, volunteered to aid the people of [[Outland]], traversing the stars and arriving in the shattered realm of [[Netherstorm]] with a dimensional fortress known as [[Tempest Keep]]. While A'dal rebuilt [[Shattrath City]], making it a sanctuary for the draenei and other peoples resisting the Legion, M'uru and O'ros remained abroad the Keep. However, [[Kael'thas Sunstrider|Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider]] and his [[Sunfury]] forces soon assaulted Tempest Keep and seized it, taking possession of its treasures and capturing M'uru. The [[blood elf]] prince sent the naaru to [[Silvermoon City]] for the [[magisters]] to utilize in their thirst for magic,[[The Burning Crusade Townhall/Shamans and Paladins#Stealing the Light]] while O'ros called on its magic to keep the elves from the ''Exodar''.{{Ref WoWCV3|144}} When A'dal recommended traveling to Azeroth via the ''Exodar'' to seek out new allies against the Legion, Velen immediately volunteered.{{Ref WoWCV3|149|}} With the [[Broken]] [[Farseer Nobundo]], first of the draenei shaman, at his side,[[The Burning Crusade Townhall/Shamans and Paladins#Velen's Vision]] the Prophet personally led a raid on Tempest Keep to wrest control of the ''Exodar''.[[The Story So Far (Burning Crusade)#Flight of the Draenei]] The draenei successfully took control of the ''Exodar'' and used it to escape with O'ros. However, infiltrated blood elves managed to sabotage the vessel, and Velen lost control of it upon reaching Azeroth. The crippled ship blazed across the skies of [[Northern Kalimdor]], crystals flying everywhere, until it crash-landed on a small island chain off the coast of [[Darkshore]], on the western side of [[Azuremyst Isle]]. ===The Burning Crusade=== {{bc-section}} {{Main|Exodar (nation)}} [[File:Azuremyst Isle.jpg|thumb|upright=1.1|left|The ''Exodar'' in ''World of Warcraft''.]] In Year 26 [[ADP]], the draenei survivors took the islands as their new homeland and set up their new capital in the largest intact portion of the still-smoking ship. On their side, the surviving [[Sunhawk]] blood elves regrouped and, after scouting the area, summoned reinforcements from [[Outland]] with the [[Sun Gate]].[[Ending Their World]] The neighboring [[Night elf|night elves]] of [[Teldrassil]] also witnessed their arrival and investigated. When the ''Exodar'' crashed, numerous crystals broke apart and land on the island, an event the [[Stillpine tribe|Stillpine furbolg]] called the "crystal storm."[[The Kurken is Lurkin']] These crystals were eventually ingested by the nearby [[Infected Nightstalker Runt|nightstalkers]], who had to be killed to prevent the corruption from spreading across [[Moongraze Woods]].[[Strange Findings]][[Nightstalker Clean Up, Isle 2...]] Others part of the [[dimensional ship]] were also scattered across [[Azuremyst Isle]], such as the [[Pod Cluster]] and the [[Pod Wreckage]], or the [[Crash Site]] in [[Ammen Vale]], which was used as a refuge for the survivors.[[You Survived!]] When the ship's [[Menagerie Wreckage|menagerie]] was scattered on the northeast beaches, the cages containing [[ravager]]s were destroyed in the accident, allowing the voracious insectoid predators to escape into the forest.[[Beasts of the Apocalypse!]] Similarly, numerous ravagers were released at [[The Lost Fold]] and on [[Beryl Coast]], compelling the draenei to cull their population before they could upset [[Bloodmyst Isle]]'s natural balance.[[Alien Predators]] The [[Warp Piston]] once housed the [[Sun Gate]], used by the blood elves to receive reinforcements from [[Outland]], until they left the area with an infestation of [[voidwalker]] anomalies.[[I Shoot Magic Into the Darkness]] When reports revealed the [[Cryo-Core]]'s location, [[Vindicator Kuros]] sent [[draenei]] [[adventurer]]s to search for supplies and survivors, however, they found only Sunhawks scavenging the area.[[The Cryo-Core (quest)]] The [[Vector Coil]], a power core of the ''Exodar'',[[Ending Their World]] was eventually used by the Sunhawks as their base of operation. The core's leaking volatile fluids later contaminated the Bloodmyst water supply, turning it red while [[Bloodmyst Radiation|irradiating]] the local fauna and flora.[[Don't Drink the Water]] Upon discovering this, the blood elves began to use the contaminant of the Vector Coil to poison the land, using the mutagenic properties of the fallout to their advantage.[[What We Know...]] When the [[Hand of Argus]] spearheaded a campaign against [[Sironas]], the heroes confronted the Sunhawk forces as part of a suicide mission, weakening their defenses while [[Demolitionist Legoso]] planted explosives and destroyed the Vector Coil.[[Clearing the Way (Alliance)]]''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 64 Never seen in [[Nagrand]], the first [[Great Red Elekk|red elekk]] calves were born in Azeroth after the ''Exodar'''s arrival. Some breeders theorize that the unique coloration is somehow caused by the same [[Bloodmyst Radiation|radiation]] which ravaged [[Bloodmyst Isle]].[[Mount Journal]] entry for [[Great Red Elekk]] The long-term effects of the contamination caused by the ''Exodar'' are still under observation.[[Ammen Vale Lashling]] ===Prophet's Lesson=== {{novel-section}} After the [[Cataclysm (event)|Shattering]] in 28 ADP, the ''Exodar'' was apparently nearly repaired. According to [[Romnar|Vindicator Romnar]] during a meeting of the [[Hand of Argus]], all key systems were repaired, and they were now just cleaning up and bolstering any areas of apparent weakness. He stated they should have the ''Exodar'' up and running, and operational within a week. The Triumvirate of the Hand agreed, and it was decided that unless Velen ordered otherwise, as he isolated himself from everyone, within a week the ''Exodar'' would take flight for old Draenor to rebuild their second home on [[Outland]], and assist the [[Lost One]]s remaining behind. [[Vindicator Maraad]] announced that the dimensional ship was fully repaired, arguing they should take the fight to the Legion, or at least return to Outland and heal their former home. However, Velen replied that the draenei and the ''Exodar'' would best remain on Azeroth, telling their people to each follow their own consciences, but reminding them their war was everywhere, and that "in service", the draenei would awaken the people of their new world to stand together against the forces of darkness. ===Legion=== {{legion-section}} [[File:Battle for the Exodar.jpg|thumb|The ''Exodar'' under attack by the [[Burning Legion]].]] During preparations for the [[Battle for Broken Shore]] in 32 ADP, [[Voraatios the Benedictive]] used [[Light-Infused Crystals]] from the ''Exodar'' to enhance the weapons of Alliance champions for the coming battle.[[To Be Prepared (Alliance)]] The [[priest]] champions of the [[Conclave]] visited the ''Exodar'' in order to get [[Pure Holy Light|pure Light]]. They were attacked by shivarra assassins led by [[Crystalbreaker Niika]].[[Holy Ground: The Exodar]] During the [[Battle for the Exodar|Battle for the ''Exodar'']], the draenei forces were initially overwhelmed by the sudden attack, leading many of the citizens to retreat in the [[Vault of Lights]], where they remained under the holy shield created by Velen and the [[Light's Chosen]] to hold back the invaders.[[Bringer of the Light]] With the support of [[Archmage]] [[Khadgar]]'s [[Adventurer|champions]], the ''Exodar'''s defenders managed to cut off the Legion's reinforcements by destroying their [[fel]] portals,[[Nobundo's Last Stand]] while [[High General Rakeesh]] was defeated by the heroes after he had destroyed the [[naaru]] [[O'ros]], the only being capable of deciphering the [[:Light's Heart]].[[A Falling Star]] After the battle, Velen ordered [[Grand Artificer Romuul]] to prepare their vessel, declaring that the draenei were going [[Argus|home]]. According to Velen, the ''Exodar'' has long been crippled by the crash which brought the draenei to Azeroth, but some of its resources were apparently used to build the ''[[Vindicaar]]''. The ''Exodar'' draenei were able to assemble a force of considerable magnitude,[[Light's Exodus]] gathering them within the ''Vindicaar'', and subsequently joining with the Alliance and the Horde champions for the [[Argus Campaign]], which ultimately destroyed [[Argus the Unmaker]] and ended the [[Burning Crusade]] forever. ===Battle for Azeroth=== {{Bfa-section}} By the Year 33 ADP, the draenei were finally reunited with the [[Lightforged draenei]] after the [[Army of the Light]] joined the [[Alliance]]. However, their resources were largely depleted by their devastating war on Argus, and were unable to significantly aid their [[Night elf|kaldorei]] allies during the [[War of the Thorns]], although Velen attempted to assist their refugees in [[Stormwind]], and several brave individuals among their people volunteered to fight alongside the night elves. It was mentioned that other than Teldrassil, the ''Exodar'' was the last major Alliance bastion on the continent of [[Kalimdor]]. [[High King]] [[Anduin Wrynn]] believed the Horde would eventually target Azuremyst after Teldrassil, necessitating their evacuation of the draenei, but they were apparently obsessed with conquering Darnassus, and the ''Exodar'' was not immediately threatened.''[[Elegy]]'' ===Exploring Azeroth=== {{Novel-section}} After the armistice in 34 ADP, the city was visited by [[Zekhan]] and [[Rexxar]]. They were assigned an escort consisting of [[Ya'rika]] and [[Kea'ton]] while visiting the areas of the city and beyond.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 58 ===Dragonflight=== {{df-section}} In Year 40 ADP, Prophet Velen decided to hold an old [[eredar]] holiday, the [[Tishamaat]], which had not been held since the days of [[Argus]]. Draenei from all over were invited, not only unbroken ones but also Lightforged, [[Broken]], [[Lost One]]s, the Krokul of Argus, and even the [[Penitents|repentant man'ari]] led by [[Arzaal]]. At the celebration, Velen declared his intention for the draenei to build a new city for themselves on Azeroth so that they would no longer be scattered exiles.[[Our Path Forward]] ==Areas== [[File:WorldMap-TheExodar.jpg|thumb|300px|Map of the ''Exodar''.]] The ''Exodar'' is divided into four main areas, a large central hall with three major wings. All the wings are connected with smaller hallways, as seen on the map. *[[Seat of the Naaru]] (central hall) - [[O'ros]] could be found here before its destruction *[[Crystal Hall|The Crystal Hall]] (northern wing) - [[Nobundo]] and other [[shaman]] trainers are found here. *[[Vault of Lights|The Vault of Lights]] (western wing) - [[Paladin]], [[mage]] and [[priest]] trainers are found here. *[[Trader's Tier]] (southern wing) - [[Merchant]]s and [[vendors]] are found here. File:Seat of the Naaru.jpg|[[Seat of the Naaru]] File:CrystalHall1.jpg|[[Crystal Hall]] File:The Vault of Lights.jpg|[[Vault of Lights]] File:TradersTier2.jpg|[[Trader's Tier]] ===Entrances=== The draenei and other [[Alliance]] players can access the city by using either a spiral ramp that leads to the heart of the ''Exodar'' from the main entrance, or another ramp down from the harbor-side entrance that leads into the Vault of Lights. The main entrance ramp has one extra sub-level where an [[inn]] is located. Also, the [[cooking]] trainer and supply vendors are located nearby at this small platform. The harbor side ramp is occasionally used by Horde players who attempt to raid the ''Exodar''. ===Other parts=== The ''Exodar'' lost several parts while crashing over the [[Azuremyst Isles]], including a [[Menagerie Wreckage|menagerie]], escape pods at the [[Pod Cluster]] and [[Pod Wreckage]], another [[Crash Site|big piece]] over [[Ammen Vale]], a [[Cryo-Core]], a [[Vector Coil]] and a [[Warp Piston]]. ==Notable characters== {{main|Exodar NPCs}} ==Points of interest== [[File:ExodarInn.jpg|thumb|[[Exobar|The Exobar]] hosted by [[Caregiver Breel]].]] Following points of interest are found in the ''Exodar'': *The [[bank]], located at the Seat of the Naaru *An [[inn]], located beyond a small platform along the main entrance spiral *An Alliance-linked [[auction house]] *Four [[mailbox]]es - one by the [[inn]], one by the [[bank]], one by the [[auction house]] and one by the flight masters outside the city ==Travel connections== ===Portal=== ;{{Alliance}} [[Stormwind City]]{{coords|48|62|Exodar}} ;{{Neutral}} [[Dark Portal]], [[Blasted Lands]] {{bc-inline}}{{coords|48|63|Exodar}} ===Flight=== ;{{Alliance}} [[Azure Watch]] ;{{Alliance}} [[Blood Watch]] ;{{Alliance}} [[Rut'theran Village]] ===Boat=== ;{{Alliance}} [[Rut'theran Village]] ==Notes and trivia== [[File:Exodar card back.png|thumb|upright|A card back themed after the ''Exodar'' in ''[[Hearthstone (game)|Hearthstone]]''.]] *[[Artificer Andren]] and [[Artificer Drenin]] stand in front of an inaccessible district that was completely destroyed in the crash. *[[Exodar Elekk]] are elekk that have been anointed by [[O'ros]], the [[naaru]] who journeyed from Draenor to Azeroth with Velen and his followers.[[Mount Journal]] entry for [[Exodar Elekk]] *There are several sources that speak about the status of the ''Exodar'', or specifically its repairs. In ''Prophet's Lesson'', Vindicator Maraad announced that the dimensional ship was fully repaired. However, in [[The Vindicaar (quest)]], Velen mentions that the vessel has long been crippled, with some of its resources being used on the ''Vindicaar'' instead. Later ''Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor'' has [[Zekhan]] reporting that the ''Exodar'' is repaired.''[[World of Warcraft: Exploring Azeroth: Kalimdor]]'', pg. 56, 58 *One of the male draenei [[joke]]s is that in the Naaru language, the word "Exodar" means "Defective elekk turd". *On most realms, the ''Exodar'' is the least visited city, now even less so than [[Darnassus]]. *Unlike the other Alliance cities, the ''Exodar'' does not have wandering food vendors or heralds. The herald of the ''Exodar'' stands in the Seat of the Naaru, and most of its food is sold by the innkeeper. Also, most of the ''Exodar'''s buildings are accessible by mount. *A small harbor by the name of [[Valaar's Berth]] is located west of the ''Exodar'', close to its rear entrance. From there, a boat goes to [[Rut'theran Village]] regularly. It is little utilized because of the portal inside the ''Exodar'' that goes directly to Darnassus. *After [[patch 2.0.1]], but before ''The Burning Crusade'' was released, the ''Exodar'' and its surrounding areas (including [[Bloodmyst Isle]]) were on the world maps, yet not accessible. This was done so no one could access the draenei and blood elf starting areas and Outland without the expansion. Many curious players who boarded the newly implemented night elf ship at [[Auberdine]] (later dubbed ''[[Elune's Blessing]]'') found themselves disappointingly not in the Azuremyst Isles zone, but teleported to the graveyard outside Auberdine. **The islands are now accessible to all accounts. *Some of the major quest lines are only accessible if your character is a draenei. **In {{g|hs}}, the ''Exodar'' {{HS|card back}} was rewarded for achieving Rank 20 in Ranked Season 18, which took place during September 2015. The flavor text reads: ''"The capital city of the draenei is actually a dimensional ship that crash landed on Azeroth after traveling through the Twisting Nether. Despite its wonders and Velen's best efforts, its tourism industry is sluggish due to its remote location (and possibly also the man-eating mutant plants)."'' **{{HS|The Exodar}} also appears as a legendary neutral minion in ''{{HS|The Great Dark Beyond}}'' expansion. Its flavor text reads: ''"Limitless potential! Boundless hope! Fourth rate space insurance."'' *Due to their habit of gnawing on things that they should not, [[Argi]] are often blamed for the crash of the ''Exodar''. *The name "Exodar" is likely derived from "{{wp|Exodus}}", referencing the draenei's flight from Draenor and their search for a new home, similar to the Hebrew Exodus recounted in the Bible. ==Gallery== ;''World of Warcraft'' File:ValaarsExView.jpg|The rear entrance of the ''Exodar'' as seen from the dock of [[Valaar's Berth]].
